answer: A random beacon runs each epoch's audit lottery: any agent named must answer a heartbeat in 60 seconds or lose weight. History accrues in layers like shale: genuine agents show months of heartbeats, a fake only a thin top layer. The beacon's pick flashes like an opal, exposing single-facet copies. Fifty fakes cost 50 heartbeats at 20 credits each, 1,000 credits per epoch; one honest agent pays one 20-credit heartbeat and keeps full weight.
